load_COMET_metric: load the COMET metric from HuggingFace evaluate for machine translation evaluation
compute_COMET_scores: compute COMET translation quality scores given source, hypothesis, and reference sentences
configure_COMET_model: configure COMET metric with a specific model checkpoint like Unbabel/wmt22-comet-da
run_COMET_on_gpu: run COMET scoring on GPU for faster machine translation evaluation
review_COMET_class: review the COMET class and its _info, _download_and_prepare, _compute methods
